_meta.title: 1 Samuel — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Curated key verses from 1 Samuel (answered prayer, God's holiness, 'speak, your servant hears,' Ebenezer, God looks at the heart, the battle is the Lord's, finding strength in God). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 9 1 Samuel); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight, proper-name en-dashes to hyphens
_meta.selection: key verses from the substantive chapters; battle/court narrative largely omitted
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: getbible's KJV renders the divine name as 'the Lord'; text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: For this child I prayed; and the Lord hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
verses.plain: I prayed for this child, and the Lord has granted me what I asked of him.
verses.visual_prompt: a rough-hewn limestone bench overlooking a quiet valley in a hillside trail above the Elah valley

verses.text: There is none holy as the Lord: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.
verses.plain: There is no one holy like the Lord; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.
verses.visual_prompt: a solitary stone cairn marking a high mountain pass under an open sky in a quiet stone sanctuary courtyard at Shiloh

verses.text: And the Lord came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.
verses.plain: The Lord came and stood there, calling as at the other times, 'Samuel! Samuel!' Then Samuel said, 'Speak, for your servant is listening.'
verses.visual_prompt: a stacked fieldstone cairn beside a winding footpath in the green pasture valleys of Bethlehem

verses.text: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath the Lord helped us.
verses.plain: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up, and named it Ebenezer, saying, 'Thus far the Lord has helped us.'
verses.visual_prompt: a solitary stone cairn marking a high mountain pass under an open sky in a quiet stone sanctuary courtyard at Shiloh near a hillside trail above the Elah valley (1 samuel 7:12 motif: then)

verses.text: Only fear the Lord, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.
verses.plain: Only fear the Lord and serve him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things he has done for you.
verses.visual_prompt: a solitary pilgrim seen strictly from the back ascending worn stone steps toward a hillside trail above the Elah valley

verses.text: But the Lord said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the Lord looketh on the heart.
verses.plain: But the Lord said to Samuel, 'Do not look on his appearance or his height. The Lord does not see as people see; people look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.'
verses.visual_prompt: an earthenware water pitcher resting on a rough stone bench in the rocky crags of En Gedi

verses.text: And all this assembly shall know that the Lord saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the Lord's, and he will give you into our hands.
verses.plain: All those gathered here will know that the Lord saves not with sword and spear; for the battle is the Lord's, and he will give you into our hands.
verses.visual_prompt: an earthenware water pitcher resting on a rough stone bench in the rocky crags of En Gedi near a quiet stone sanctuary courtyard at Shiloh (1 samuel 17:47 motif: assembly)

verses.text: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the Lord his God.
verses.plain: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him; each was bitter in spirit because of their sons and daughters. But David found strength in the Lord his God.
verses.visual_prompt: an earthenware water pitcher resting on a rough stone bench in the rocky crags of En Gedi near a quiet stone sanctuary courtyard at Shiloh (1 samuel 30:6 motif: david)
